name: ab_tick_duration
description: A/B: single note sustain — c4 repeated at cps=0.5, notes should not be unnaturally short
script: announce SUSTAIN TEST: c4 c4 c4 c4 (sawtooth, cps=0.5)
strudel edit note("c4 c4 c4 c4").s("sawtooth").pianoroll() cps=0.5
announce SUSTAIN TEST: Reference for comparison
strudel ref note("c4 c4 c4 c4").s("sawtooth").pianoroll() cps=0.5
check ab_harmonics ref.wav ours.wav extract:match_pct > 80 label:harmonics
